{{Quote|Red Eleven standing by.|Wenton Chan|<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
'''Wenton Chan''' [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]], where he gained flight experience by [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhoppers]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Chan volunteered to serve the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], joining their [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|starfighter corps]] and flying a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]]. By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he held the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]. Chan was assigned to [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] as [[Red Eleven/Legends|Red Eleven]], and was stationed at [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Once the location of the hidden base had been discovered by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces, Chan was part of the Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] forces mobilized to attack the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], the Empire's [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-destroying [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. During the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle]], Chan was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in combat, although the Alliance secured victory by destroying the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].

==Biography==
Wenton Chan was a [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]<ref name="CACW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref> of [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]],<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" /> growing up in a wealthy, privileged family.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> He learned to fly by [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhoppers]],<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" /> but eventually left his family and [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] due to their connections to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Chan became a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and gunrunner,<ref name="EGTW" /> before eventually joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Serving in the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]],<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" /> he was assigned to the [[Griffon Flight Wing]].<ref name="EGTW" /> By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="SWE" /> Chan had attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]],<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" /> and had been assigned to [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]]<ref name="EGTW" /> stationed at the hidden headquarters of the Alliance, [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="A New Hope" /> Chan operated under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Red Eleven/Legends|Red Eleven]],<ref name="CSWE" /> and led the unit's third [[Flight group/Legends|flight]].<ref name="EGTW" />

Following the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Yavin Base was discovered by the commanders of the Galactic Empire's new [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Imperial forces, under the direction of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], had planted a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. The ship's crew and passengers&mdash;which included the smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], as well as the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[Farm/Legends|farmboy]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]&mdash;had infiltrated the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]].<ref name="A New Hope" />

On board, they effected the rescue of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], Alderaan's former [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and a high-ranking member of the Rebel Alliance. They were allowed to flee the Death Star&mdash;carrying the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] of the new [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] with them&mdash;so that the Empire could track them to the hidden Rebel base. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], commander of Yavin Base, analyzed the plans and found a weakness<ref name="Dodonna's Story">{{WEGCite|story=Dodonna's Story|book=Galaxy Guide 1: A New Hope}}</ref>&mdash;a [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]], located in one of the Death Star's surface trenches, would be vulnerable to a [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] assault. A successful attack would trigger a chain reaction that would destroy the station.<ref name="A New Hope" />

[[File:Exds.png|thumb|left|250px|The Death Star's destruction]]
Following the homing beacon concealed on the ''Millennium Falcon'', the Death Star entered the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. As the Death Star approached Yavin 4, the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] at the base mobilized to meet the incoming threat. Under the command of [[Garven Dreis/Legends|Garven Dreis]], Chan launched in his [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] alongside the other members of Red Squadron.<ref name="A New Hope" /> During the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle]], Chan was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]];<ref name="SWE" /> however, the Alliance secured victory when another member of Red Squadron, Luke Skywalker, completed a dangerous run down the target trench and released proton torpedoes into the thermal exhaust port. The Death Star was destroyed, saving the personnel at Yavin Base and ending the threat the battlestation posed to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="A New Hope" />

==Personality and traits==
A light-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]],<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" /> Wenton Chan grew up in a life of privilege. Despite his favored upbringing, Chan rejected his family due to their connections to the Galactic Empire, opting for a life living on the fringe, and, eventually, as a Rebel pilot.<ref name="EGTW" /> He often volunteered for dangerous duty within the Alliance.<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" />

==Equipmment==
Chan was equipped with an [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Rebel flight suit]] and a [[Flight helmet/Legends|flight helmet]] adorned with two blue [[Alliance Starbird]]s. The helmet's visor was tinted in a dark color.<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wenton Chan first appeared in [[1977]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] as an unnamed Rebel fighter pilot during the hangar launch sequence prior to the attack on the Death Star.<ref name="A New Hope" /> His scene was filmed on H Stage at [[Shepperton Studios]] in [[Wikipedia:London|London]] between [[June 9]] and [[June 14|14]], [[1976]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars]]''</ref> [[1995|Eighteen years after ''A New Hope'']], [[Decipher]] released the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]; one of the cards in the [[Premiere Limited]] set identified the pilot as Wenton Chan, a Corulag native.<ref name="Premiere-RebelPilot" /> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' gave him the callsign of Red Eleven,<ref name="CSWE" /> thus linking him to the offscreen voice of Red Eleven's self-identification in the ''A New Hope'' film.<ref name="A New Hope" /> A [[2012]] [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]-wielding X-wing pilot figure in the non-[[canon]] ''[[LEGO Classic Star Wars]]'' set was later identified as Wenton Chan in a display at the [[2014]] San Diego Comic Con.<ref name="FBTB">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fbtb.net/lego-star-wars/2014/07/24/sdcc-the-lego-star-wars-minifigure-gallery|text=SDCC - The LEGO Star Wars Minifigure Gallery at FBTB.net|archivedate=20200929031301}}</ref>
